summary: Agent 0.34.0 (ADR-0088): on Windows the children run as NT AUTHORITY\LOCAL SERVICE instead of LocalSystem. Before every start the agent derives the folders a child needs from cmd, cwd, env and args (plus read_paths/write_paths), checks each one by impersonating LOCAL SERVICE and grants what is missing with icacls /L: read outside its data folder, modify only on the child's own folder below it. Never granted: drive roots, system folders, whole user profiles, the agent's own files, paths behind links; modify outside the data folder only where nobody besides the administrators can change the path. A child whose access cannot be established is refused, never started as SYSTEM. run_as: system needs run_as_reason. check-config checks without granting.

findings.evidence: Children (llama.cpp, the STT stack, Strata) handle network input and ran as LocalSystem; a memory-safety bug yielded SYSTEM (ADR-0087).
findings.resolution: They run as LOCAL SERVICE (no administrator rights; measured: NVML set denied, 19 of 666 process paths, 0 user hives). Grants are derived, checked as that account and minimal; refusal instead of fallback.

findings.evidence: Found in this review: icacls follows links by default. Whoever may replace a configured folder (a model folder in a user's profile) with a junction could choose where the agent, as LocalSystem, grants LOCAL SERVICE access; with write_paths, a program folder.
findings.resolution: A path that is or lies below a reparse point is never granted (checked per component, so 8.3 names are not mistaken for links); icacls runs with /L; modify outside the child's own data folder only where the ADR-0085 exposure check finds nobody besides the system and administrators. Residual: a read grant on a user-changeable folder keeps a check-to-grant race that could move a read entry; documented in ADR-0088.

tests.command: go test ./... (Windows, not elevated), go vet (Windows, GOOS=linux), gofmt
tests.evidence: ok; derivation, too-broad rule, ensureAccess states, link and user-folder refusal, grant ACE incl. inheritance, run_as validation, supervisor refusal.

tests.command: go test (Windows, elevated, as on the CI runner): AccessAs|GrantLocalService|EnsureAccess|ChildAccess|Exposure|Refuses|ProbeChildRestricted
tests.evidence: impersonation: a folder only administrators may read is denied to the restricted token, readable after an Everyone grant, not writable; the caller keeps its identity.

tests.command: go vet + go test ./... on Linux (WSL)
check-config of the built 0.34.0-pre once as LocalSystem on a Windows node (check only, no grant)
tests.evidence: every child reported as localservice; derived access matches the earlier measurement: model folder read needs grant, the children's own data folders modify needs grant, program folders and the STT model ok.
ADR index ok: 88 ADRs; control flow ok.

limitations: Starting children under LOCAL SERVICE through the supervisor needs LocalSystem and is confirmed by the node check during the rollout (Ollama with a loaded model, STT CUDA, Strata on request, guard power limit).
Strata's model folder is named only in its run file and needs read_paths on the node.
